The '''Samix sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] near [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]]. It was on the fringes of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
